test_can_replace_layer: test the BaseLayerWithLoRA.can_replace_layer classmethod to check if a source layer can be replaced by a LoRA layer
create_lora_weights: create LoRA weight matrices by calling create_lora_weights on a BaseLayerWithLoRA instance with max_loras and lora_config
set_lora_weights: set LoRA tensors on a BaseLayerWithLoRA instance at a given index with lora_a and lora_b tensors
reset_lora_weights: reset LoRA weights at a specific index back to zero on a BaseLayerWithLoRA instance
slice_lora_tensors: slice LoRA A and B tensors for tensor parallelism using slice_lora_a and slice_lora_b methods
